svg.title: A test utterance through the finished recognizer. Said: "two yes go visual". Heard: "two yes go visual".
svg.desc: Three panels on a shared time axis: the log-mel spectrogram of a four-word utterance, the per-frame probabilities of the blank, the space and each letter of the transcript, and the probability of not-blank over time showing isolated spikes.
svg.text: A test utterance through the finished recognizer. Said: "two yes go visual". Heard: "two yes go visual".
PER-FRAME PROBABILITIES, ONE OUTPUT FRAME EVERY 20 MS (WHAT COMES OUT)
PROBABILITY THAT A FRAME IS NOT BLANK: SHORT SPIKES, ONE OR TWO FRAMES PER LETTER
